import pandas as pd

# Read the CSV file
df = pd.read_csv('~/Documents/GitHub/gaia-agent/runs/practice_files/p04-csv-pm25-ranking/air_quality_hourly.csv')

# Check for missing values
print("Missing values in pm25_ugm3:", df['pm25_ugm3'].isna().sum())
print("Unique stations:", df['station'].unique())
print("Number of unique stations:", df['station'].nunique())

# Calculate mean PM2.5 per station (ignoring NaN values)
station_means = df.groupby('station')['pm25_ugm3'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
print("\nMean PM2.5 per station (highest first):")
print(station_means)

# Get top 3
top_3 = station_means.head(3)
print("\nTop 3 stations:")
print(top_3.index.tolist())
